correctness.rationale: The focal condition is a double eigenvalue d_k for D-xx^T. Negative rank-one interlacing places it at the adjacent eigenslots k-1,k, excluding adjacent k. For any independent S, interlacing target eigenvalues at upper/lower endpoints plus midpoint choices and a last point at d_n or d_n-delta give exactly the prescribed duplicated slots. Nonnegative residues p_mu(d_i)/p_D_prime(d_i) reconstruct real x by the determinant lemma; the rank-one complementary block has nullity<=1 so all repeats have multiplicity exactly two. The n=4 D=(10,6,3,1) example has four intersection points and repeated eigenvalues (6,6,1,1), shifted Jacobian (3,3,-2,-2). Independent exact rational calculations sampled all independent S through n=9 and verified the relevant characteristic-polynomial reconstruction; the all-n proof is analytic, not finite sampling.
